messages:
maria: Heads-up — seeing increased 502s from eu-dedicated customers after yesterday's edge config tweak. Repro on prod: auth header missing on some requests. Triage points to header-strip regression in edge-proxy during nginx merge.
deploybot: Automated check: candidate image redwood/edge-proxy:2.4.2-hotfix available. Suggested canary: eu-dedicated pool. Rollback criteria: >2% 5m 502s OR >150ms p95 increase sustained 5m. Requires 2 engineer approvals + QA smoke.
sam_ops: Running quick smoke now. pinging @tessa_qa for signoff.
tessa_qa: Starting smoke runs against canary (token + oauth flows). Will report within 5m.
leo_release: ACK. If QA green i'm +1. Recommend pin to 2.4.2-hotfix and minimal staged rollout.
anika_pm: Customer impact? Need copy for any outbound.
maria: Impacting ~5 dedicated customers intermittently. I'll draft a short customer note for support. Root cause = nginx config merge that strips Authorization when upstream annotation missing.
tessa_qa: Smoke update: 10m in, auth flows ok on canary (50% traffic). No 502 spikes observed.
sam_ops: +1 from ops. proceeding with deploy. I'll monitor dashboards and alerts.
deploybot: Command issued: `/deploy edge-proxy image=redwood/edge-proxy:2.4.2-hotfix target=eu-dedicated-canary rollout=5% wait=5m`
deploybot: Canary at 5%: health checks OK. metrics snapshot: 0.4% 502, p95 +20ms. Rolling to 50%.
oncall_duty: Oncall here — tracking live alerts. Setting pager threshold to 2% 502s. If triggered we rollback to 2.4.0 immediately.
maria: Draft release note: "Fix edge-proxy header-merge bug that caused 502s for some dedicated customers. Rollout: redwood/edge-proxy:2.4.2-hotfix to eu-dedicated. No data loss. Contact support for customer-specific impact." Link: https://go.redwood/release-notes/2.4.2-hotfix
leo_release: +1 on release note. Can we lock rollout observation window to 30m after full roll?
sam_ops: 50% stable for 10m: metrics now 0.1% 502, p95 +10ms. Moving to 100%.
deploybot: Rollout complete: deployed redwood/edge-proxy:2.4.2-hotfix to eu-dedicated pools. Monitor window started (30m).
maria: Thanks all. @support_bot please prep customer messages and route to assigned CSMs. I'll check back on monitor status at +30m and close thread. :white_check_mark:
